asus.label: ASUS RTX Spark (128 GB unified)
asus.notes: Best reasoning in the fleet, but the slowest. Give it the hardest design-heavy work: new systems, tricky bugs, cross-cutting changes.

desktop.label: Ryzen 9800X3D + RTX 5090
desktop.notes: Fastest machine, but it plans and designs every task full time and only builds when there is nothing to plan or design, so it gets through fewer tasks than its speed suggests. Give it medium features: new mechanics, scenes, UI, juice, audio.

yoga.label: Lenovo Yoga RTX Spark (32 GB unified)
yoga.notes: Heavily quantized and small context. Only small, precisely specified tasks: tuning numbers, small unit tests, one small juice or polish touch (a sound, a flash, a text), tiny single-function changes; a new content file only when it passes the content bar. Always name the exact file and the closest example.

desktop-4070.label: Ryzen 7 5800X + RTX 4070 SUPER (12 GB)
desktop-4070.notes: Heavily quantized (IQ3_XXS): expect more mistakes. Partly offloaded to CPU, so slow. Give it medium features: new mechanics, scenes, UI, juice, audio.
